Name: sales for the current month
Query:
Select a.DocNum, a.DocDate, a.CardCode, a.CardName, a.DocTotal from oinv a where a.CANCELED='N' and datepart(month, a.docdate)=MONTH(getdate())
	and DATEPART(YEAR, a.DocDate)=year(getdate())

Select b.ItemCode, c.ItemName, sum(b.Quantity) as SalesQuantity, sum(b.LineTotal) as SalesValue from oinv a join inv1 b on a.DocEntry=b.DocEntry  
	join OITM c on c.ItemCode=b.ItemCode
	where a.CANCELED='N' and datepart(month, a.docdate)=MONTH(getdate())
	and DATEPART(YEAR, a.DocDate)=year(getdate())
Name: Itemwise Sales For the current month
Item not sold in the current month
Salesman wise Sales Orders for the current month
Query:
select d.SlpCode SalesPersonCode, d.SlpName SalesPersonName, sum(a.DocTotal) as TotalValue from 
	ORDR a join RDR1 b on a.DocEntry=b.DocEntry join OCRD c on c.CardCode=a.CardCode 
	join OSLP d on d.SlpCode= coalesce(a.SlpCode, c.SlpCode)
	where a.CANCELED='N' and datepart(month, a.docdate)=MONTH(getdate())
	and DATEPART(YEAR, a.DocDate)=year(getdate()) group by d.SlpCode, d.SlpName

select coalesce(a.CardCode, b.CardCode) as CardCode, coalesce(a.CardName, b.CardName) as CardName, 
	a.TotalSales as Sales1stHalf, b.TotalSales as Sales2ndHalf, 
	((coalesce(b.TotalSales,0)-coalesce(a.TotalSales,0))*100.0)/nullif(a.TotalSales,0) as GrowthPercentage
from 
(Select a.CardCode, c.CardName, SUM(a.DocTotal) as TotalSales from OINV a join OCRD c on 
	a.CardCode=c.CardCode where a.CANCELED='N' and a.DocDate >='20220101' and a.DocDate <'20220701' 
	group by a.CardCode, c.CardName) a
	full join
(Select a.CardCode, c.CardName, SUM(a.DocTotal) as TotalSales from OINV a join OCRD c on 
	a.CardCode=c.CardCode where a.CANCELED='N' and a.DocDate >='20220701' and a.DocDate <'20230131'  
	group by a.CardCode, c.CardName) b on a.CardCode=b.CardCode order by GrowthPercentage desc
Name: Comparison of customerwise sales between 2 periods

Query:
SELECT 
    T0.CardName AS [Customer Name], 
    T0.DocNum AS [Invoice No], 
    T0.DocDate AS [Invoice Date], 
    T0.DocDueDate AS [Due Date], 
    MAX(T5.MaxDate) AS [Payment Date], 
    DATEDIFF(day, T0.DocDueDate, MAX(T5.MaxDate)) AS [Days Delay]
FROM OINV T0
JOIN ITR1 T1 ON T1.SrcObjAbs = T0.DocEntry AND T1.SrcObjTyp = T0.ObjType
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT MAX(T4.RefDate) AS MaxDate 
    FROM ITR1 T3 
    JOIN OJDT T4 ON T3.TransId = T4.TransId 
	join OITR t6 on t6.ReconNum=t3.ReconNum and t6.Canceled='N'
    WHERE T3.ReconNum = T1.ReconNum AND T3.IsCredit = 'C'
) T5
WHERE T0.CANCELED = 'N' 
  AND T0.DocStatus = 'C' 
GROUP BY T0.CardName, T0.DocNum, T0.DocDate, T0.DocDueDate
ORDER BY T0.CardName, [Days Delay] DESC
